# sommarioz

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

The goal of sommarioz is to provide functions and data sets that are used in the case-studies of the e-book (Biometry:The 5Rs).

## Installation

ou can install the development version of sommarioz from
[GitHub](https://github.com/mario24Freo/sommarioz) with:

``` r
remotes::install_github("mario24Freo/sommarioz")
```
